prompt: Which statements about pipelines are correct?
explanation: Pipelines batch many commands into fewer round trips, which is their entire purpose. They are not transactions: the server may interleave commands from other clients between pipelined commands, and atomicity needs MULTI/EXEC or Lua instead.

options.text: A pipeline reduces network round trips by batching many commands into one request
Commands in one pipeline execute atomically as a group
The server may interleave commands from other clients between a pipeline's commands
A pipeline only works when wrapped in MULTI/EXEC
